reviews.title: I really enjoy the fonts, but ads and payment is annoying
reviews.text: When I first downloaded this app a few years ago, all fonts were free as well as all symbols. AI stickers have not been released yet a few years later you had to watch three ads to use the fonts, and one ad to use the symbols. To me this was fine. I didn’t care as long as it was free. It was a little irritating that I had to spend time watching ads, but I was ok with it as long as I got to use the fonts and symbols. I don’t know how long we got this happened, but I recently discovered that now you have to select a payment option of some sort (weekly, monthly, yearly etc.) in order to use anything on this app. To me the evolution of slowly not being able to use Fonts as it goes is just very frustrating. It feels like when the app first came out I wasn’t required to pay for anything but now it definitely does. I don’t use Fonts every day. I just enjoy them for decorations on my phone and making texts look pretty occasionally. And I would like to add I don’t think anybody uses these every single day of their life. That’s why it’s extremely annoying. I’m not going to pay for something that I don’t use every day and don’t need. Especially if it’s just a random decoration on my phone. I really enjoyed this app and I enjoy making my texts look pretty but I will not be paying for this and I think it’s frustrating how it went from being completely free to costing money. (And there are so many ads now just when you’re in the app, it’s also very aggravating.)
